warrior.name: Militech
warrior.description: The largest private military contractor in the world. Militech deploys heavily armored combat units across every battlefield.
warrior.hero_power: Deploy Unit: Spawn a 1/2 taunt minion

priest.name: Trauma Team
priest.description: Platinum-grade medical response with full combat authorization. They'll save your life, then bill you for it.
priest.hero_power: Combat Stim: Give a random friendly minion +2/+1

hunter.name: Kang Tao
hunter.description: Chinese weapons manufacturer specializing in smart weapons and tracking technology. Every target is marked, catalogued, eliminated.

warlock.name: Voodoo Boys
warlock.description: Haitian netrunner gang obsessed with breaching the Blackwall. They drain neural data like digital vampires.
warlock.hero_power: Data Siphon: Leech 2 HP from the opponent's hero

demonhunter.name: Arasaka
demonhunter.description: The most powerful megacorporation on Earth. Their operatives are surgical, precise, and absolutely ruthless.
demonhunter.hero_power: Precision Strike: Deal 1 HP to the left+right most minions. 2 HP if 1 minion or 3 HP to the hero if no minion

rogue.name: Night Corp
rogue.description: The shadowy corporation that owns Night City itself. They operate from the darkness, secrets within secrets.
rogue.hero_power: Shadow Operative: Spawn a 2/1 minion with charge and stealth

paladin.name: NCPD
paladin.description: Night City Police Department. Underfunded, outgunned, but they show up in numbers when corpo interests are threatened.

shaman.name: Aldecaldos
shaman.description: Nomad family clan from the Badlands. Masters of improvised tech, turrets, and guerrilla warfare.
shaman.hero_power: Deploy Turret: Spawn a 0/1 minion that deals 2 HP to the opponent's hero at the end of your turn

druid.name: Biotechnica
druid.description: Bioengineering megacorp growing organic solutions to every problem. Life finds a way, especially when patented.
druid.hero_power: Biosynth Growth: Spawn a 1/1 minion, restore 2 HP to your hero

mage.name: NetWatch
mage.description: Government netrunners policing the Net. Their quickhacks strike like lightning, random but devastating.
mage.hero_power: Cyber Attack: Randomly deal 3 HP to enemies
